# External backend attribution

`algebraicRLtest` is an external implementation cited in the manuscript.
Repository: https://github.com/TesfayZ/algebraicRLtest
Pinned commit: 687c868c204b8ec537451b5e046532de80197d9d.

The four Python modules in `algebraicRLtest/` are unmodified copies from that
commit, provided for offline reproduction. Their original MIT license is
preserved in `algebraicRLtest/LICENSE`. The benchmark uses ideal membership,
normal forms and polynomial evaluation from these modules. `bugs.py` and
`envs.py` additionally support independent Acrobot checks.

The repository and the associated reference publication are attributed as
existing work; this notice makes no statement about the submission authors.
